details.description: KAT-Coder is Kwaipilot's (Kuaishou's AI team) flagship agentic coding model, built for real-world software-engineering work such as feature implementation, bug fixing, refactoring and test generation. Fireworks AI, which hosts the version served under this id as "KAT-Coder-Pro V1", lists it at 235 billion parameters with a 262,000-token context window. Unlike Kwaipilot's open-weight KAT-Dev models, KAT-Coder itself is not open-weight; Kwaipilot's own site says it is reached via an API key on the StreamLake platform.
advantages: Resolves 73.4% of tasks on SWE-bench Verified, per Kwaipilot's own report.
Kwaipilot reports 32% fewer multi-turn interactions compared to its SFT-stage models after large-scale reinforcement learning.
Supports parallel tool calling, invoking multiple tools simultaneously rather than one at a time, per Kwaipilot.
Trained through a multi-stage pipeline of mid-training, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement fine-tuning and scalable agentic reinforcement learning, per Fireworks AI's model page.
disadvantages: Not open-weight; Kwaipilot's site says KAT-Coder is reached only via an API key on the StreamLake platform, unlike its open-weight KAT-Dev siblings.
use_cases: Feature implementation and enhancement in existing codebases
Automated test generation and code understanding
Agentic software-engineering workflows with sandboxed tool use

notes: Fireworks AI's host page identifies the model served at this id as "KAT-Coder-Pro V1" (235B params, ~262K context), matching the catalog's context-window facts (262144) and distinguishing it from Kwaipilot's separate open-weight 35B "KAT-Coder-V2.5-Dev" on Hugging Face. Description and evaluation draw on Kwaipilot's own KAT-Coder landing page, which does not break figures out by sub-version. The Kwaipilot/KAT-Coder GitHub repo is only a marketing landing page with no published code or weights, so no github_url is claimed.
